name: Duskframe Tailvent Infiltration Set
description: Designed from the ground up for runners with significant geneware — specifically those with tails, bioluminescent skin, or other visible biological modifications that make standard tactical gear a liability. The jacket is a mid-length structured piece in deep teal-grey with a matte finish, cut wide at the hip with a full-length dorsal vent that runs from the small of the back to the hem, sealed with a continuous pressure-release zipper that can be opened single-handed. The vent accommodates prehensile tails up to approximately 90cm without binding, and the zipper teeth are coated in a thermal-neutral compound that won't read against body heat on infrared. The jacket's interior is lined with scanner-diffusing baffling and carries four concealed weapon channels — two at the chest, one cross-draw at the left hip, one lower-right for a compact sidearm. The base layer beneath is a long-sleeve in deep charcoal with integrated bioluminescence-dampening panels along the forearms and collar — for runners whose geneware glow would otherwise give them away in dark environments, these panels absorb and redirect the light output inward, effectively dimming visible bioluminescence by approximately 70%. The trousers are wide-leg dark olive with a reinforced tail-channel waistband, articulated thighs, and two deep cargo pockets with internal dividers for tool organization. Footwear is a low-profile wrap boot in matte anthracite synth-leather with a segmented sole for quiet movement and adjustable ankle closures that work with non-standard foot morphology. A slim waist wrap in dark indigo provides additional concealed storage and can be released as a distraction throw.
functionality: Full-length dorsal tail vent with single-hand pressure-release zipper; bioluminescence-dampening forearm and collar panels; four concealed weapon channels; scanner-diffusing jacket lining; tail-channel reinforced waistband; adjustable ankle closures for non-standard foot morphology; segmented quiet-movement sole; concealed waist-wrap storage; infrared-neutral zipper coating
what_it_says: This outfit acknowledges that geneware isn't a liability if you plan around it. The runner wearing this has made peace with what they are and found a way to make it tactical. The bioluminescence-dampening panels and the tail vent aren't apologies — they're engineering. It reads as Tier 2-3 to most people, just someone with visible geneware moving through Circuit, which is common enough to be unremarkable.
worn_by: operatives with tails or bioluminescent modifications
runners who can't pass as baseline human and have stopped trying
manufacturer: Duskframe Collective — independent street label, gene-mod community origin
story_hooks: The bioluminescence-dampening panels have been functioning at reduced capacity since a chemical exposure two jobs back — in a dark server room, the runner's forearms begin to glow faintly through the fabric at exactly the wrong moment.

A corpsec checkpoint has a new scanner specifically calibrated to detect the thermal-neutral zipper compound used in gene-compatible tactical gear, suggesting someone in the runner community has been feeding equipment intel to the corponation.

The runner is hired specifically because of their visible geneware — the client needs someone who will be remembered as 'the one with the tail' to draw attention away from the real operative working the same job in plain clothes.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, asymmetrical tactical ensemble designed for augmented bodies. The mid-length jacket dominates with its structured silhouette and dramatic rear vent, creating a predatory, ready-for-movement aesthetic. Wide hip cut and long lines read as purposefully concealing. The full outfit presents as dark, matte, and deliberately non-reflective — built to vanish into shadow.
physical_description.fit: Oversized through the chest and hip with tailored articulation at the thighs and ankles. The dorsal vent runs center-back without constraining movement. Jacket sleeves are precisely cut to allow weapon access. Trousers sit relaxed at the waist but taper with intentional bias at the calf.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte thermal-neutral ballistic weave jacket exterior; scanner-diffusing baffled lining. Base layer in treated synthesis-cotton. Trousers in reinforced dark-dyed composite twill. Boots in matte anthracite synth-leather with pressure-resistant sole structure.
physical_description.texture: Jacket exterior is smooth and matte with subtle horizontal grid texture from scanner baffling visible through strategic gaps. Base layer shows fine ribbed texture. Trouser fabric has a soft nap finish. Boot leather is grainy and deliberately scuffed to avoid light reflection.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary palette: deep teal-grey jacket, charcoal base layer, dark olive trousers, anthracite boots. Accent: dark indigo waist wrap. Overall monochromatic with cool undertones — designed to blend urban concrete and shadow.
physical_description.closures: Continuous pressure-release dorsal zipper on jacket (single-hand operable, thermally neutral teeth). Magnetic snap chest pockets. Friction-fit weapon channels. Adjustable velcro-and-snap ankle closures on boots. Wrap waist secured with tactical toggle release.
distinctive_features: Full-length dorsal vent with pressure-release zipper accommodating tails up to 90cm
Four concealed weapon channels (two chest, left hip cross-draw, lower-right compact sidearm)
Bioluminescence-dampening panels on forearms and collar (70% light reduction)
Articulated thigh sections for dynamic movement
Segmented sole on boots for acoustic dampening
Detachable indigo waist wrap with distraction-throw capability
Deep cargo pockets with internal dividers
Thermally neutral zipper compound for infrared evasion
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 functional with Tier 2 technical specifications. Expensive enough to indicate professional runner status, but street-manufactured rather than corpo-produced. Price point: mid-range professional gear.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street runner culture, specifically genemod community and augmented population. Signals: tactical expertise, visible biological modification, active evasion operations, underground collective loyalty. Worn by those who move through restricted spaces and need to move fast. Anti-corpo aesthetic with practical black-ops functionality.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in but meticulously maintained. Jacket shows minor scuffing on shoulders and hem from use. Zipper track may show subtle wear. Base layer potentially shows faint bioluminescent staining if wearer's mods are active. Boots develop characteristic creasing but remain functionally pristine. Overall: field-ready, not showroom.
